say:1:1012434001:0.text: Maybe you should get your eyes checked, Lorsan.
say:1:1012434001:0.source_cn: 洛桑，你的眼睛怎么了？进了沙子吗？

say:2:1012434002:0.text: No, I think I saw a black butterfly again. The people of Ivoryshade say that black butterflies foretell disastrous events... I'm a little worried.
say:2:1012434002:0.source_cn: 不是，我刚刚好像又看到了黑蝴蝶。月影乡的人说，黑蝴蝶预...

say:4:1012434004:2.text: That could be affecting me... I haven't been able to sleep well.
say:4:1012434004:2.source_cn: 有可能……最近都没能好好睡觉。

say:5:1012434005:1.text: Don't be scared. It's not the first time we've encountered the black butterflies. With the great Magister Merlin here, we'll be fine!
say:5:1012434005:1.source_cn: 别怕，我们也不是第一次遇见它啦。有伟大的梅林在，绝对不...
say:5:1012434005:1.male: Don't be scared. It's not the first time we've encountered the black butterflies. With the great Magister Merlin here, we'll be fine!
say:5:1012434005:1.female: Don't be scared. It's not the first time we've encountered the black butterflies. With the great Magister Merlin here, we'll be fine!

say:6:1012434006:2.text: Yes, I need to get it together! It's Prayer Day. Let's hurry to the Spirit Mound and seek answers from Misarte.
say:6:1012434006:2.source_cn: 说的也是！我得打起精神。祈福日到了，我们赶紧前往鹿灵圣...

say:7:1012434007:1.text: Eironn and Bryon are already there. Let's go meet up with them.
say:7:1012434007:1.source_cn: 埃隆和布莱恩已经过去了，我们在那边与他们汇合吧。

say:0:1012437001:0.text: What are these things? They look like some kind of fruit.
say:0:1012437001:0.source_cn: 这是……什么东西？它看着像是一颗果实。

say:1:1012437002:0.text: I'm not really sure, either. Maybe a villager knows. Let's ask around.
say:1:1012437002:0.source_cn: 我也不是很清楚，也许当地居民知道，我们问问看。

say:1:1012439001:2.text: Outlander, after you defeated the Mysalinds just now, your figures were enveloped in a gentle white light. I don't know what that means.
say:1:1012439001:2.source_cn: 外乡人，刚才你们打败迈萨林德后，你们的身影便被一道温柔...
say:1:1012439001:2.male: Outlander, after you defeated the Mysalinds just now, your figures were enveloped in a gentle white light. I don't know what that means.
say:1:1012439001:2.female: Outlander, after you defeated the Mysalinds just now, your figures were enveloped in a gentle white light. I don't know what that means.

choice_prompt:2:1012439001.text: Outlander, after you defeated the Mysalinds just now, your figures were enveloped in a gentle white light. I don't know what that means.
choice_prompt:2:1012439001.source_cn: 外乡人，刚才你们打败迈萨林德后，你们的身影便被一道温柔的白光笼罩了，我不知道发生了什么。
choice_prompt:2:1012439001.male: Outlander, after you defeated the Mysalinds just now, your figures were enveloped in a gentle white light. I don't know what that means.
choice_prompt:2:1012439001.female: Outlander, after you defeated the Mysalinds just now, your figures were enveloped in a gentle white light. I don't know what that means.

say:3:1012439002:0.text: Ah, you have passed the Mysalinds' test and gained Misarte's guidance. Have you gotten the answers you wanted?
say:3:1012439002:0.source_cn: 原来如此，你们通过了迈萨林德的考验，它引导你们获得了弥...

choice_prompt:4:1012439002.text: Ah, you have passed the Mysalinds' test and gained Misarte's guidance. Have you gotten the answers you wanted?
choice_prompt:4:1012439002.source_cn: 原来如此，你们通过了迈萨林德的考验，它引导你们获得了弥萨忒的指引。你们已经得到想要的答案了吗？

say:5:1012439003:0.text: High Priestess, after we sought guidance from the Deer Spirit, it bestowed this upon us. Do you know what this is?
say:5:1012439003:0.source_cn: 大祭司，我向鹿灵寻求指引后，它将此物赐予了我们。你知道...

say:7:1012439005:0.text: Legend has it that before her fall, Misarte hid the Sylvan Egg in Ivoryshade. For many years, the Sylvan Egg has been waiting for someone who needs it most.
say:7:1012439005:0.source_cn: 传说，弥萨忒在陨落之前，将翡绿之卵藏在了月影乡的圣丘之...

say:8:1012439006:0.text: The appearance of the black butterfly means disaster will befall us... Outlander, you've come all this way to Ivoryshade. Is disaster finally at our doorstep?
say:8:1012439006:0.source_cn: 黑蝴蝶的出现意味着灾厄……外乡人，你们专程来到月影乡，...
say:8:1012439006:0.male: The appearance of the black butterfly means disaster will befall us... Outlander, you've come all this way to Ivoryshade. Is disaster finally at our doorstep?
say:8:1012439006:0.female: The appearance of the black butterfly means disaster will befall us... Outlander, you've come all this way to Ivoryshade. Is disaster finally at our doorstep?

choice_prompt:9:1012439006.text: The appearance of the black butterfly means disaster will befall us... Outlander, you've come all this way to Ivoryshade. Is disaster finally at our doorstep?
choice_prompt:9:1012439006.source_cn: 黑蝴蝶的出现意味着灾厄……外乡人，你们专程来到月影乡，是因为灾厄已经降临了吗？
choice_prompt:9:1012439006.male: The appearance of the black butterfly means disaster will befall us... Outlander, you've come all this way to Ivoryshade. Is disaster finally at our doorstep?
choice_prompt:9:1012439006.female: The appearance of the black butterfly means disaster will befall us... Outlander, you've come all this way to Ivoryshade. Is disaster finally at our doorstep?

say:10:1012439007:0.text: This is terrible... I fear not only for the Lucent Tree. If the corruption is not removed, I'm afraid all of Esperia will be in danger.
say:10:1012439007:0.source_cn: 太可怕了……恐怕不止是流荧树，倘若腐化无法被清除，大地...

say:11:1012439008:0.text: My worst nightmare has come true. Those men in black will destroy the Vaduso Mountains!
say:11:1012439008:0.source_cn: 我的噩梦应验了，那些身穿黑衣的人很可能毁灭瓦度索山脉！

choice_prompt:12:1012439008.text: My worst nightmare has come true. Those men in black will destroy the Vaduso Mountains!
choice_prompt:12:1012439008.source_cn: 我的噩梦应验了，那些身穿黑衣的人很可能毁灭瓦度索山脉！

say:13:1012439009:0.text: I dreamt of a group of men dressed in black wandering around Ivoryshade. They looked similar to the men of the Adamant Syndicate that you claimed to have corrupted the Lucent Tree!
say:13:1012439009:0.source_cn: 我梦见一群穿着黑衣的人在月影乡附近蠢蠢欲动，他们的身影...

say:14:1012439010:1.text: You've seen the Adamant Syndicate in your dreams? Do you know where they are located?
say:14:1012439010:1.source_cn: 你在梦中见过黑金商会？他们在什么地方出没？

say:15:1012439011:2.text: I saw a map which showed many caves in the nearby mountains. The tunnels were elaborate and <style="highlight">perfect for hiding from sight</style>.
say:15:1012439011:2.source_cn: 我曾见过一张地图，地图上显示，附近的山脉里有许多洞窟，...

say:16:1012439012:1.text: Eomir may be hiding among them.
say:16:1012439012:1.source_cn: 伊米尔很可能就躲在其中。

say:17:1012439013:1.text: I will not forgive, Eomir! We should search the area and try to find some clues!
say:17:1012439013:1.source_cn: 绝不能放过伊米尔！我们应该去附近搜查一番，也许能找到蛛...

say:1:1012441001:0.text: What did Elona say to you, Bryon? She seems anxious.
say:1:1012441001:0.source_cn: 布莱恩，艾洛娜和你说什么了？它好像很着急。

say:2:1012441002:0.text: We agreed that she should visit Taran Village as we're both concerned about the situation there.
say:2:1012441002:0.source_cn: 我担心塔兰村的情况，派艾洛娜回去了一趟。

say:3:1012441003:0.text: She told me that the corruption of Lovers' Wish has gotten worse due to the influence of the Lucent Tree. This has put Hewynn in a terrible state.
say:3:1012441003:0.source_cn: 它告诉我，受流荧树影响，情人之愿的腐化越来越严重，而伊...

say:4:1012441004:1.text: I'm afraid we'll have to return to Taran Village as soon as possible.
say:4:1012441004:1.source_cn: 恐怕我们得尽快返回塔兰村。

say:5:1012441005:1.text: As much as I worry about Hewynn, we finally have a lead on Eomir.
say:5:1012441005:1.source_cn: 虽然我也很担心伊温，但是，不继续追查伊米尔吗？好不容易...

say:6:1012441006:1.text: Will we ever find him again if he runs away now? He harmed the Dark Forest. He must pay!
say:6:1012441006:1.source_cn: 万一他跑得更远了，下次我们要如何才能找到他？他伤害了薄...

say:7:1012441007:2.text: How about I stay here, Lyca?

say:8:1012441008:1.text: If Eomir is really hiding nearby, I should be able to hear him. Leave this trivial matter to me.
say:8:1012441008:1.source_cn: 如果伊米尔真的躲在附近，我应该能听见他的声音！这种小事...

say:9:1012441009:2.text: Stop messing around! You're no match for him!
say:9:1012441009:2.source_cn: 不许乱来！你不是他的对手，不准擅自行动！

say:11:1012441011:2.text: You don't know what you're talking about! Lorsan always gets in over his head!
say:11:1012441011:2.source_cn: 别添乱！洛桑的水平你还不清楚？

say:12:1012441012:1.text: I know what I'm doing, Lyca. Don't worry about me. If there's danger, I know how to escape.
say:12:1012441012:1.source_cn: 姐，我自有分寸，你别担心我了。遇到危险，我知道该如何逃跑。

choice_prompt:13:1012441012.text: I know what I'm doing, Lyca. Don't worry about me. If there's danger, I know how to escape.
choice_prompt:13:1012441012.source_cn: 姐，我自有分寸，你别担心我了。遇到危险，我知道该如何逃跑。

say:14:1012441013:1.text: That's right. If things get dangerous, I'll just hightail it out of there.
say:14:1012441013:1.source_cn: 对呀，就算打不过，遇到危险，我起码知道该往哪跑啊。

say:15:1012441015:1.text: Lyca, do you recall what you told Eironn? If you can't trust others, how can you ask others to do the same?
say:15:1012441015:1.source_cn: 莱卡，还记得你说给埃隆的话吗？自己都做不到的事，又怎么...

say:16:1012441016:2.source_cn: 我……\n好吧……真是败给你了，布莱恩。

say:17:1012441017:1.text: Lorsan, you must promise me that you will protect yourself.
say:17:1012441017:1.source_cn: 洛桑，你要答应我，必须保护好自己。

say:18:1012441018:1.text: Not a problem! Go ahead, everyone. When you get back, I bet I'll have some wonderful news to share with you.
say:18:1012441018:1.source_cn: 没问题！你们快去快回。等你们回来，我一定会用好消息迎接...

choice:13:0:1.text: Lyca, you need to trust Lorsan.
choice:13:0:1.male: Lyca, you need to trust Lorsan.
choice:13:0:1.female: Lyca, you need to trust Lorsan.

say:20:1012441014:1.text: Yes! I still remember the first time I met Magister Merlin. I was also running away at the time.
say:20:1012441014:1.source_cn: 没错！我还记得第一次遇见梅林大人，就是在逃跑的路上！
say:20:1012441014:1.male: Yes! I still remember the first time I met Magister Merlin. I was also running away at the time.
say:20:1012441014:1.female: Yes! I still remember the first time I met Magister Merlin. I was also running away at the time.

choice:13:1:2.text: Lorsan's got luck on his side.
choice:13:1:2.male: Lorsan's got luck on his side.
choice:13:1:2.female: Lorsan's got luck on his side.

say:1:1012442001:0.text: It seems that you've successfully acquired the Sylvan Egg.
say:1:1012442001:0.source_cn: 看样子，你们成功得到了翡绿之卵。

say:2:1012442002:1.text: Master Arden, how do you know this is the Sylvan Egg?
say:2:1012442002:1.source_cn: 贤者，您怎么知道这是翡绿之卵？

say:3:1012442003:1.text: Could it be... you've been to Ivoryshade?
say:3:1012442003:1.source_cn: 难道……你已经去过月影乡了？

say:4:1012442004:2.text: Ah, Bryon, my wise student. Nothing gets past you.
say:4:1012442004:2.source_cn: 布莱恩，令我骄傲的学生。什么都瞒不过你。

say:5:1012442005:1.text: Yes, before you all arrived, I found Ivoryshade and met the Deer Spirit.
say:5:1012442005:1.source_cn: 不错，在你们到来之前，我找到了月影乡的所在，并在那里见...

say:6:1012442006:1.text: The Deer Spirit tasked me to guide you there. Misarte wanted to meet you all.
say:6:1012442006:1.source_cn: 我是受鹿灵所托，指引你们前往月影乡。弥萨忒期待着与你们见面。

say:7:1012442007:1.text: I'm relieved that you passed her test.
say:7:1012442007:1.source_cn: 你们成功通过了祂的考验，我很欣慰。

say:8:1012442008:1.text: Is it possible to purify the Lucent Tree with the Sylvan Egg?
say:8:1012442008:1.source_cn: 使用翡绿之卵，是否能净化流荧树？

say:9:1012442009:2.text: No one knows unless one tries.
say:9:1012442009:2.source_cn: 不进行尝试，如何能得出结论。

say:10:1012442010:1.text: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
say:10:1012442010:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我听说你擅长净化魔法。
say:10:1012442010:1.male: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
say:10:1012442010:1.female: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.

choice_prompt:11:1012442010.text: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
choice_prompt:11:1012442010.source_cn: 梅林大人，我听说你擅长净化魔法。
choice_prompt:11:1012442010.male: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
choice_prompt:11:1012442010.female: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.

say:13:1012442011:1.text: Master Arden, Magister Merlin used a lot of magic in the Dark Forest and needs to recover.
say:13:1012442011:1.source_cn: 雅顿贤者，梅林大人在薄暮丛林耗费了大量魔力，身体很虚弱。
say:13:1012442011:1.male: Master Arden, Magister Merlin used a lot of magic in the Dark Forest and needs to recover.
say:13:1012442011:1.female: Master Arden, Magister Merlin used a lot of magic in the Dark Forest and needs to recover.

say:14:1012442012:0.text: Then, we can only have Hewynn try. The purification ritual is very powerful magic. In her current state, I don't know if she'll be able to succeed.
say:14:1012442012:0.source_cn: 那么，只能让伊温试试了。净化魔法是非常高级的术式，以她...

say:16:1012442013:0.text: Yes, I don't know if I can complete the ritual right now.
say:16:1012442013:0.source_cn: 光靠我目前的力量……恐怕……

choice_prompt:17:1012442013.text: Yes, I don't know if I can complete the ritual right now.
choice_prompt:17:1012442013.source_cn: 光靠我目前的力量……恐怕……

say:18:1012442014:0.source_cn: 谢谢你……你真是个温柔的魔法师。

say:20:1012442018:0.text: Magister Merlin, let's do the purification ritual together.
say:20:1012442018:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，一起使用净化魔法吧。
say:20:1012442018:0.male: Magister Merlin, let's do the purification ritual together.
say:20:1012442018:0.female: Magister Merlin, let's do the purification ritual together.

choice:17:0:1.text: I'm here to help if you need.
choice:17:0:1.male: I'm here to help if you need.
choice:17:0:1.female: I'm here to help if you need.

say:23:1012442015:0.text: We can not let you use all your magic. I'll help too!
say:23:1012442015:0.source_cn: 不能让您一人消耗魔力，我也要帮忙！
say:23:1012442015:0.male: We can not let you use all your magic. I'll help too!
say:23:1012442015:0.female: We can not let you use all your magic. I'll help too!

say:25:1012442016:0.text: Hewynn, you're in bad shape. Don't push yourself.
say:25:1012442016:0.source_cn: 伊温……你的状态这么差，别逞强啊。

say:26:1012442017:0.text: Thank you for worrying about me, but I can do it. I failed to protect the Taran River. It's my duty to help.
say:26:1012442017:0.source_cn: 谢谢你为我担心，我可以的。没能保护好塔兰河……我有责任...

say:1:1012443001:0.text: Looking at this beautiful sea of flowers... It feels as if I've become three hundred years younger. I think I will compose a poem about the events that transpired here.
say:1:1012443001:0.source_cn: 望着这片美丽的花海，我仿佛一下子年轻了三百多岁，甚至想...

say:2:1012443002:0.text: But this is not the time for that... Bryon, look to the sky. Elona is looking for you.
say:2:1012443002:0.source_cn: 不过……还不是时候啊。布莱恩，看向天空吧，艾洛娜来找你了。

say:5:1012443004:1.text: Elona? I told you to stay in Ivoryshade. Why are you here...?
say:5:1012443004:1.source_cn: 艾洛娜？！我让她留在月影乡，她飞到这里，难道是……

say:8:1012443006:1.text: Bryon, what did Elona say? Has something happened to Lorsan?
say:8:1012443006:1.source_cn: 布莱恩！艾洛娜说了什么？是不是洛桑那边出事了？

say:9:1012443007:0.text: The Ivory Tree shows <style="highlight">signs of corruption</style>...
say:9:1012443007:0.source_cn: 皎月树出现了<style=highlight>腐化的迹...

say:11:1012443008:0.text: What?! Magister Merlin completed the purification ritual. How could the corruption have spread to Ivoryshade?
say:11:1012443008:0.source_cn: 什么……梅林大人已经施展了净化魔法，腐化怎么会蔓延到月影乡？
say:11:1012443008:0.male: What?! Magister Merlin completed the purification ritual. How could the corruption have spread to Ivoryshade?
say:11:1012443008:0.female: What?! Magister Merlin completed the purification ritual. How could the corruption have spread to Ivoryshade?

say:13:1012443009:0.text: It seems the current state of the Sylvan Egg isn't enough to overcome the corruption completely.
say:13:1012443009:0.source_cn: 看样子，现在的翡绿之卵还不足以完全根除腐化。

say:14:1012443010:3.text: The only reason you were able to cleanse this area was because Hewynn and Magister Merlin's combined magic triggered the remaining life force in the Sylvan Egg.
say:14:1012443010:3.source_cn: 你们能净化这片区域，是因为梅林大人和伊温的魔法，激活了...
say:14:1012443010:3.male: The only reason you were able to cleanse this area was because Hewynn and Magister Merlin's combined magic triggered the remaining life force in the Sylvan Egg.
say:14:1012443010:3.female: The only reason you were able to cleanse this area was because Hewynn and Magister Merlin's combined magic triggered the remaining life force in the Sylvan Egg.

say:15:1012443011:0.text: In other words, a part of Misarte's divine power was retained in the Sylvan Egg. It seems that the Sylvan Egg is actually <style="highlight">a vessel for storing power</style>.
say:15:1012443011:0.source_cn: 换言之，那是弥萨忒留存于翡绿之卵的部分神力。看样子，翡...

say:17:1012443013:0.source_cn: 贤者，能麻烦您解释得清楚些吗？

say:18:1012443014:1.text: To fully cleanse it, I'm afraid you'll have to destroy Eomir in order to retrieve the life force he stole from the Lucent Tree.
say:18:1012443014:1.source_cn: 想要完全净化流荧树，恐怕免不了和伊米尔决一死战，拿回被...

say:19:1012443015:1.text: And the purpose of the Sylvan Egg is to absorb this life force so that, even after slaying Eomir, it does not vanish.
say:19:1012443015:1.source_cn: 而翡绿之卵的作用，是完全吸纳这些力量，避免打败伊米尔后...

say:21:1012443016:1.text: But how can we find Eomir?
say:21:1012443016:1.source_cn: 可是我们要如何找到伊米尔的行踪？

say:22:1012443017:1.text: There is no need to be hasty. A path will appear.
say:22:1012443017:1.source_cn: 不必心急，道路自会出现。

say:23:1012443018:0.text: One tree does not make a forest. You'll need the strength of all your companions. For now, go and help Lorsan first.
say:23:1012443018:0.source_cn: 一木不能成林，你们需要同伴的力量，眼下，先去帮助洛桑吧。

say:0:1012444001:0.text: Even the Ivory Tree has been corrupted...
say:0:1012444001:0.source_cn: 竟然连皎月树都遭到了腐化……

say:1:1012444002:0.text: Where's Lorsan? We need to find Lorsan fast!
say:1:1012444002:0.source_cn: 洛桑呢？得赶紧去洛桑那里！

say:2:1012444003:0.text: Calm down, I can hear him. I'll guide the way.
say:2:1012444003:0.source_cn: 冷静点，我能听见洛桑的声音，我来指出方位。

say:1:1012447001:1.text: Scared me half to death... I thought I was going to die just now. I was imagining everyone singing "Rock-a-bye-Bunny" at my funeral.
say:1:1012447001:1.source_cn: 吓死我了……差点以为今天将成为我的忌日，我都想好葬礼上...

say:2:1012447002:1.text: Do you remember, Lyca? You always sang this song to me when I was little.
say:2:1012447002:1.source_cn: 莱卡，你记得吗？小时候你总唱这首歌给我听。

say:3:1012447003:1.text: You goat-kissing fool! If you had died today, I would've made Bryon send your cursed ashes to the end of the world!
say:3:1012447003:1.source_cn: 少说这些！你今天要是死了，我会让布莱恩把你的骨灰吹到世...

say:4:1012447004:1.text: Oh, that's a bit much. I was just kidding.
say:4:1012447004:1.source_cn: 你也太过分了……我只是开个玩笑。

say:5:1012447005:1.text: That felt excessive to me as well.

say:6:1012447006:1.text: Thank you for taking my side, Bryon.

say:7:1012447007:1.text: I would've merely sent your ashes out of the Dark Forest. Do you think that's far enough, Magister Merlin?
say:7:1012447007:1.source_cn: 吹出薄暮丛林就可以了。你说呢，梅林大人？
say:7:1012447007:1.male: I would've merely sent your ashes out of the Dark Forest. Do you think that's far enough, Magister Merlin?
say:7:1012447007:1.female: I would've merely sent your ashes out of the Dark Forest. Do you think that's far enough, Magister Merlin?

choice_prompt:8:1012447007.text: I would've merely sent your ashes out of the Dark Forest. Do you think that's far enough, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:8:1012447007.source_cn: 吹出薄暮丛林就可以了。你说呢，梅林大人？
choice_prompt:8:1012447007.male: I would've merely sent your ashes out of the Dark Forest. Do you think that's far enough, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:8:1012447007.female: I would've merely sent your ashes out of the Dark Forest. Do you think that's far enough, Magister Merlin?

say:9:1012447008:1.text: I simply wanted him to know the consequences of not cherishing his life.
say:9:1012447008:1.source_cn: 我不过是让他知道，不珍惜生命的下场。
say:9:1012447008:1.male: I simply wanted him to know the consequences of not cherishing his life.
say:9:1012447008:1.female: I simply wanted him to know the consequences of not cherishing his life.

say:10:1012447010:0.text: I got it! I won't make those types of jokes anymore...
say:10:1012447010:0.source_cn: 我知道了！我不开那种玩笑就是……

say:13:1012447012:1.text: Wow! Eironn, is that a smile I see? All this time, I thought you'd forgotten how to smile.
say:13:1012447012:1.source_cn: 哇哦！埃隆，难得看到你笑。这段时间，我还以为你都忘记该...

say:14:1012447013:3.text: Let's get back on point. Lorsan, let's start by telling you about the situation at Lovers' Wish.
say:14:1012447013:3.source_cn: 咳咳——言归正传。洛桑，我们先和你说说情人之愿那边的情况。

narration:15:1012447014:1.text: You updated Lorsan on what happened.

say:16:1012447015:1.text: What...? The Sylvan Egg isn't enough to cleanse the corruption... We still have to defeat Eomir? On top of that, make sure we don't let the life force dissipate...
say:16:1012447015:1.source_cn: 什么……光是得到翡绿之卵，并不能完全消除腐化……还要打...

say:17:1012447016:1.text: Yes, so did you find any traces of Eomir?
say:17:1012447016:1.source_cn: 所以，你找到伊米尔的行踪了吗？

say:18:1012447017:1.text: I didn't find Eomir, but you all saw the Adamant Syndicate here. They broke through Misarte's ward and rushed into Ivoryshade.
say:18:1012447017:1.source_cn: 虽然我没有找到伊米尔，但你们刚才也看到那些黑金商会的人...

say:19:1012447018:1.text: These Syndicate henchmen built a bridge and came from the south. I also heard a lot of people talking in the southern caves. The Adamant Syndicate is probably gathering over there.
say:19:1012447018:1.source_cn: 这群人搭了一座桥，从南边过来，我能听见南边的山洞里有许...

say:20:1012447019:1.text: Eomir's injured and can't move around easily. Since they're allies, the Syndicate wouldn't have abandoned him.
say:20:1012447019:1.source_cn: 伊米尔受了伤，跑不远，而且，既然黑金商会愿意和他联手，...

say:21:1012447020:1.text: I'm not saying the Adamant Syndicate can be trusted. However, the Lucent Tree has not been completely corrupted. I think they still need Eomir.
say:21:1012447020:1.source_cn: 虽然不能指望黑金商会这群人讲信誉，但是，流荧树没能彻底...

say:22:1012447021:1.text: Therefore, it would be my guess that the Adamant Syndicate is protecting Eomir. If we can find their base, we can find Eomir.
say:22:1012447021:1.source_cn: 因此，我大胆猜测——伊米尔被黑金商会保护着。找到黑金商...

say:25:1012447023:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿……你能认可，我很高兴。

say:26:1012447025:2.text: So many Syndicate members in one place. I also believe one of their bases could be nearby.
say:26:1012447025:2.source_cn: 这么多黑金商会总不至于凭空出现，我也相信附近隐藏着他们...

say:27:1012447026:1.text: Even if we can't find Eomir, it's time to eliminate these grove killers from the forest.
say:27:1012447026:1.source_cn: 就算暂时找不到伊米尔，也该把这些藏在森林里的蛀虫消灭。

say:28:1012447027:1.text: I agree, otherwise they may raid Ivoryshade again. Misarte herself has blessed this holy place. It cannot be defiled.
say:28:1012447027:1.source_cn: 我认同你的想法，否则，他们还会再次入侵月影乡。这里是弥...

say:29:1012447028:1.text: I believe Misarte will guide us. She surely would wish for peace to return to the region.
say:29:1012447028:1.source_cn: 我相信弥萨忒会指引我们，祂一定也不愿看到有人在自己的圣...

say:31:1012447029:1.text: Master Arden said that <style="highlight">a path will appear</style>.

say:32:1012447030:1.text: Doubt is not needed... Let us move forward.

say:34:1012447024:1.text: Yeah, it could be a wild goose chase, but we've got no other options right now. Why not give it a go?
say:34:1012447024:1.source_cn: 是吗……但眼下似乎也没有别的路可走。不如试试看吧？
say:34:1012447024:1.male: Yeah, it could be a wild goose chase, but we've got no other options right now. Why not give it a go?
say:34:1012447024:1.female: Yeah, it could be a wild goose chase, but we've got no other options right now. Why not give it a go?

choice:8:1:2.text: I think that's far enough, Bryon.
choice:8:1:2.male: I think that's far enough, Bryon.
choice:8:1:2.female: I think that's far enough, Bryon.

subtitle:1:1012436101:.text: Please guide us... like a star in the night sky.
subtitle:1:1012436101:.source_cn: 请您指引我们……如启明星那般

cinematic_dialogue:1:1012435001:.text: It's the guardian beasts of Ivoryshade!
